items.item_text: Certified Pharmacy Technician: CA and Certified Pharmacy Tech, (CPHT National Certification)
Completion of Certified Tech Program. Eligible for licensure as Pharmacy Tech with the Board of Pharmacy.
1-3 years One (1) year previous hospital pharmacy experience, or formal pharmacy tech school with certification.
1.1 Initiates patient IV labels through the Meditech system. Accurately debits and credits orders. Notifies pharmacist of all unusual orders and requests clarification of such orders.
1.2 Participates in reconciliation and exchange each morning and corrects problems discovered during reconciliation in approximately 30 minutes upon return to pharmacy.

1.3 Prepares and completes the compounding of the IV and corresponding label for the pharmacist to check by 2:00 p.m. daily. Sanitizes entire hood daily; maintains daily cleaning log and records temperatures daily.
1.4 Prepares IVs using sterile techniques as defined by procedure; sanitizes hood and walls daily.
1.5 Double-checks all admixtures for clarity and potential incompatibilities, bringing any problems to the attention of the pharmacist.

1.6 Delivers the compounded IVs to designated nursing units before 2:30 p.m. and retrieve all IVs doc's or not used from the floors to minimize wastage and confusion. Freezes expensive IVs as soon as possible.
